options.text: Their fists are different widths, so the same bench gives different counts.
The bench grew longer between Farhan's and Kavya's measurements.
Only Farhan measured correctly because a larger count always means a better measurement.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Farhan and Kavya measure the same classroom bench along its length using their own fist-widths. Farhan gets 12 fist-widths. Kavya gets 10 fist-widths.

part_answers.answer: A body unit that differs from person to person can give different counts for one fixed length; the bench did not change, and a larger count is not automatically better.

teacher.key_rationale: Different fist-widths give different counts for the same length. The bench did not change size, and a larger count is not automatically better.
